column1: # THE PLANT FOR `checks/residue.py`. TAB SEPARATED, five columns:

column2: relpath <TAB> content <TAB> EXPECTED VERDICT <TAB> age_seconds <TAB> tracked
(content is ONE field and contains no tab; a row with a tab in it is refused, not guessed at)

column1: # THE `expect` COLUMN IS A LITERAL. No code computes it. A check that compares itself to itself proves
# only that it agrees with itself -- one tokenizer in this project ate a full stop and its own belt
# missed the same stop, because the belt shared the regex's assumption. So the oracle here is data a
# person typed, and the tree is built out of the same rows.
# `checks/residue.py --plant` builds this in a temp directory, `git init`s it so citation belt A is
# git's REAL `-w -F` matcher rather than a stand-in, applies the `age` column with `os.utime`, and
# asserts every verdict. NO PRODUCTION FILE IS TOUCHED: one repro in this project read `LEFT=NOTHING`
# on BOTH sides because it `rmtree`d the state under test between beats.
# `checks/residue.py --disarm RESOLVER` builds it again with one resolver OFF and REQUIRES a failure.
# A harness that cannot move produces a confident wrong answer.
# The residue roots are the real ones (`.agents/slop`, `runs`) so the plant exercises the production
# walk, and `keep/` is outside the residue: a citer there counts, a citer inside does not.
# AUTHORED. `checks/differ.py::declared()` renders `D1-graph-matmul.txt` and its `.err` twin, so a
# file of that name is AUTHORED regardless of content, location, or existence. `sweep`'s citation test
# sees neither: both are f-string renderings, not literal tokens. This is the group that decides
# whether the DELETE bucket counts junk or counts files the corpus indexes by the wrong key.
.agents/slop/D/D1-graph-matmul.txt
.agents/slop/D/D1-graph-matmul.txt.err
# NOT AUTHORED. Rendered-LOOKING is not rendered: `nosuch` is not in `declared()`, and the plant fails
# if a shape match ever stands in for the authority call.
.agents/slop/D/D1-graph-nosuch.txt
# DERIVED. A `__pycache__` entry is regenerated by `import`, so it is decided BY CONSTRUCTION and needs
# no measurement. `keep/m.py` shares the stem and proves the tree can hold the same name outside.
.agents/slop/p/__pycache__/m.cpython-312.pyc
keep/m.py
# LIVE, AND THE POINT IS THE AGES. `cold-looking.txt` is 30 DAYS old and `whatever.txt` is 0 seconds
# old, and they share a directory. Per-FILE mtime -- which is all `sweep.live_set` has -- calls the
# first one cold. Per-DIRECTORY aggregation calls the whole directory live, needs no roster, and
# therefore cannot go stale the way `LIVE_UNITS` did: six finished units, 2,353 files, 53% of the tree,
# every one of them named by nothing outside themselves.
.agents/slop/fresh/cold-looking.txt
.agents/slop/fresh/whatever.txt
# CITED. A whole-path token OUTSIDE the residue names it, and BOTH belts must agree. Naming something
# is what puts a row in CITED; it is a lower bound on value, never a sufficient condition for a bucket.
.agents/slop/cited/named.py
keep/namer.py
# THE TWO TRAPS THE BELTS EXIST FOR, AND THEY ARE ONE TEST. `keep/liar.py` names `xgraphcmp.py` in a
# comment and says the word `a.error`. So: `xgraphcmp.py` IS CITED (the token is exact), `graphcmp.py`
# is NOT (the token is a different, longer word and `in` IS NOT A CITATION TEST), and `a.err` is NOT
# (`a.error` is a different token). The plant fails if a belt ever agrees with the other by sharing an
# assumption.
# `a.err` is an OUTPUT with no witness, so it is UNNAMED. `graphcmp.py` is a TOOL with no witness, so it
# is UNKNOWN -- and it is the SAME directory and the SAME missing report as `a.err`, which is the whole
# point of the extension test: an output nobody names is junk, a tool nobody names is a question about
# a person. Only whole-token matching plus that distinction produces these three answers.
.agents/slop/traps/a.err
.agents/slop/traps/graphcmp.py
.agents/slop/traps/xgraphcmp.py
keep/liar.py
column2: a.error and xgraphcmp.py appear in this comment alone

column1: # COPY. sha256-identical to a file outside the residue, which is the only reason a duplicate is
# disposable: `git show` is the copy. The twin is named in the row's `why`.
.agents/slop/cp/copy.rows
keep/orig.rows
# UNKNOWN, AND THE ONE THAT FIRED FOR REAL. `000-the-residue.md` names every residue row by path, so
# the moment it is STAGED the next run finds every row cited by this check's own report and the
# residue collapses to nothing UNNAMED. A citation from the instrument that is measuring itself is not
# a citation. Belt C exists because the exclusion alone cannot notice itself being undone.
.agents/slop/self/x.rows
.agents/slop/residue/000-the-residue.md
# UNKNOWN. A TOOL whose own directory has no committed report. The only thing that could ever explain
# this row is missing, and the fix is attached to the row: commit the report. An OUTPUT in the same
# position (the `.rows` below) is UNNAMED, because an output nobody names is junk and a tool nobody
# names is a question about a person -- and the difference is the extension, not a judgement.
.agents/slop/w/plant.py
.agents/slop/w/out.rows
# UNNAMED. Tracked, nothing renders it, nothing names it, not live, not derived, not a copy. A
# CANDIDATE for deletion and NOT a verdict: "nothing I can measure names this" and "this is junk" are
# different sentences, and only the first one is true here.
.agents/slop/u/orphan.rows
# UNKNOWN. Untracked and unreferenced. `sweep` calls this DELETE, which is not a verdict but the
# ABSENCE of one, and it is the only bucket `--apply` destroys. The row carries the test that settles
# it instead. `u/README.md` is committed ON PURPOSE: without a witness here the `witness` resolver
# would answer UNKNOWN too and `--disarm untracked` would move nothing, which is how a branch stops
# being computed without anybody noticing.
.agents/slop/u/new-thing.py
.agents/slop/u/README.md
# UNKNOWN. Excluded by the house rules. An excluded row is STILL COUNTED, because a group excluded from
# the walk is a group hidden rather than analysed, and a hidden group is the LIVE_UNITS shape again.
.agents/slop/dd-cone-wt/arm1/dtype.bend
.agents/slop/strays/artifacts/blob
